Overview & City Profile

Rorschach (Rorschach (BFS 3215)) is a municipality in Wahlkreis Rorschach, Saint Gallen (coordinates 47.4757°N, 9.4949°E; population 9,438). Visitors use Rorschach as a base to explore Saint Gallen's historic town centers, regional markets, and culinary specialties such as Cheese fondue, Raclette, Rösti.

Within Saint Gallen Region (Wahlkreis Rorschach region), Rorschach (Rorschach (BFS 3215)) serves as a municipality (gemeinde / commune) in saint gallen region. Travelers exploring Saint Gallen often combine a stop in Rorschach with regional highlights such as Historic Altstadt / Old Town, Panoramic mountain & lake views, Marked SwitzerlandMobility hiking trails, Local heritage museum.

Getting to Rorschach & Getting Around

Via the regional hub (St. Gallen Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)): Connected via hourly SBB CFF FFS rail and PostBus services; fully covered by the Swiss Travel Pass.

  • Local rail & IC cards: Once in Saint Gallen Region, JR regional lines and local private railways connect St. Gallen with Rorschach. Nationwide IC cards (Transit Card, Pasmo, Icoca) work on major urban and JR commuter gates; for rural branch lines or local buses, keep CHF 1,000 bills and CHF 100 coins handy for the onboard fare box.
  • Luggage & station lockers: Main stations in Saint Gallen have coin lockers for day-trippers. If you are stopping in Rorschach en route between larger bases, check your suitcase dimensions in our Luggage & Locker Checker or forward big bags ahead with Takkyubin.
  • Driving & car rental: While city centers around Rorschach are accessible by train and taxi, renting a car from a major SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways station or airport in Saint Gallen can be rewarding for reaching mountain gorges, coastal viewpoints, and countryside onsen. Read our Renting a Car in Switzerland Guide.

Practical Travel Tips for Rorschach

  • Tourist information center (観光案内所): Look for the Kankō Annaijo counter inside or right outside the main train station in Rorschach (or at St. Gallen Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)) for free walking maps, bus timetables, and festival calendars.
  • Cash & ATMs: While hotels, chain stores, and convenience stores in Rorschach accept international cards and IC payment, smaller family-run restaurants, shrines, and rural buses often prefer cash. 7-Eleven (Seven Bank) and Switzerland Post ATMs accept foreign debit cards reliably.
  • Dining hours: Outside major metropolitan hubs, lunch typically runs 11:30 AM–2:00 PM and dinner spots open around 5:30 PM, with earlier last orders (around 8:00–9:00 PM) in smaller cities.

Frequently asked questions

Where is Rorschach (Rorschach (BFS 3215)) located in Switzerland?

Rorschach (Rorschach (BFS 3215)) is a municipality (gemeinde / commune) located in Saint Gallen Region in the Wahlkreis Rorschach region of Switzerland (coordinates: 47.4757°N, 9.4949°E). It has a population of approximately 9,438 across an area of Regional km².

How do I get to Rorschach by train?

Most visitors reach Rorschach via the main prefectural gateway of St. Gallen Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways). Connected via hourly SBB CFF FFS rail and PostBus services; fully covered by the Swiss Travel Pass. From the regional hub, connect by JR local/rapid lines, private commuter railways, or local bus to Rorschach. You can estimate long-distance rail costs using our SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways Fare Calculator.

What local food is Rorschach and Saint Gallen known for?

In Rorschach and across Saint Gallen Region, top local dishes include Cheese fondue, Raclette, Rösti, as well as Bircher muesli and Swiss artisanal chocolate. Look for local ekiben (station bento boxes), morning markets, and family-run shokudo near the main station.

When is the best time of year to visit Rorschach?

Best time to visit Saint Gallen: Jun–Sep (summer trails), Dec–Mar (winter sports). Check our Switzerland Seasonal Calendar to compare month-by-month weather and crowd levels.
